simple.meaning: שֵׁן (shên) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “a tooth (as sharp ); specifically ivory ; figuratively, a cliff.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.short: a tooth (as sharp ); specifically ivory ; figuratively, a cliff
definitions.full: H8127. shen I. שֵׁן noun feminine 1Sam 2:13 (yet masculine 14:5 compare Dr) tooth, ivory ; — ׳שׁ absolute Exod 21:24 +, construct 21:27 +, ׳שֶׁן Deut 32:24 ; suffix שִׁנּם Exod 21:27 ; dual שִׁנַּיִם Prov 10:26 , construct שִׁנֵּי Jer 31:29 +; suffix שִׁנֵּיהֶם Psa 124:6 , שִׁנֵּימוֺ 58:7 , etc.; — 1 tooth: a. of man , Exod 21:27 (3 t. in verse) (E), Num 11:33 (J), Gen 49:12 (poem in J), Amos 4:6 ; Song 4:2 ; 6:6 , ׳שׁ רֹעָה Prov 25:19 , see II. רעע 2 ; of lex talionis , ׳שׁ שׁ ׳תַּחַת Exod 21:24 (E), Lev 24:20 (H), בְּשׁ ׳שֵׁן Deut 19:21 ; irritated by acid Prov 10:26 , dulled by it (in proverb of inherited guilt) Jer 31:29-30 , Ezek 18:2 ; שׁ ׳חָרַק Lam 2:16 ; Job 16:9 ; Psa 35:16 ; 112:10 , see חָרַק ; בְשִׁנָּ֑י בְשָׂרִי אֶשָּׂא Job 13:14 = risk my life (strike out עַלמָֿה , dittograph; || נַפְשִׁי מִּי בְּכַּ אָשִׂים ); שִׁנָּ֑י בְּעוֺר 19:20 , see מָלַט Hithpa`el (other conjectures see Di Bi Bu Du). b. of beasts : Deut 32:24 , crocodile Job 41:6 , locusts Joel 1:6 (teeth of lions); especially figurative of false prophets Micah 3:5 , of foes Zech 9:7 , oppressors Job 29:17 , wicked 4:10 ; Psa 3:8 ; 58:7 ; 124:6 ; of their weapons Prov 30:14 ; Psa 57:5 ; of Israel shattered by ׳י . c. tooth of a fork, tine , 1Sam 2:13 (compare Dr Sm. 291 ); of cliff, הַסֶּלַע שֵׁן 14:4 (twice in verse), compare Job 39:28 , הַשֵּׁן 1Sam 14:5 . 2 ivory , of commerce, שֵׁן קַרְנוֺת Ezek 27:15 (i.e. tusks? ); as material, שׁ ׳מִטּוֺת Amos 6:4 , ׳כִּסֵּאשֿׁ 1Kin 10:18 2Chr 9:17 , הַשּׁ ׳בֵּית 1Kin 22:39 , compare Amos 3:15 , שׁ ׳הֵיכְלֵי Psa 45:9 , also Ezek 27:6 ; Song 5:15 ; 7:5 . שׁנן (√ of following; see Biblical Hebrew [ שָׁנַן ], שֵׁן ).
